standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes separatedness from the established uniqueness property.

core_obligations: Set up the valuative diagram for the diagonal: take a valuation ring with fraction field and a pair of dotted arrows exhibiting two sections of the diagonal over the same diagram (proof lines 9632-9650)

Deduce equality: the hypothesis of uniqueness for the original morphism, applied after the base change that expresses a morphism of dotted arrows for the diagonal as two dotted arrows for the original morphism, implies that the two sections agree (proof lines 9651-9668)

Conclude: the valuative criterion for separatedness applies to the diagonal, so the diagonal is separated, and separatedness of a morphism means precisely separatedness of its diagonal in this formulation (proof lines 9669-9680)
proof_roadmap: 取赋值环 A、分式域 K 与点箭头；把对角线的一条点箭头理解为原态射的两条点箭头。
由原态射的唯一性假设，这两条点箭头相同 ⇒ 对角线的点箭头唯一。
由分离性的赋值判据得 Δ 分离，即 f 分离。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that uniqueness in the valuative criterion for a morphism of algebraic stacks implies that its diagonal is separated (author lemma at source lines 9625-9630, label lemma-converse-uniqueness-and-diagonal). The proof (source lines 9632-9681) interprets a morphism of dotted arrows for the diagonal as two dotted arrows for the original morphism, applies the uniqueness hypothesis to force them to agree, and concludes by the valuative criterion for separatedness (proof lines 9632-9680). The translation between dotted arrows for the diagonal and pairs of dotted arrows for the morphism is the substance. H3.
